extensionDescription.message: Random passwords, field insertion, and secure local history.

startupError.message: Could not start the generator. Close and reopen QuietPass.

clipboardError.message: Could not copy the password. Try again.

copyHistoryFailed.message: Password copied, but it could not be saved to history.

insertHistoryFailed.message: Password inserted, but it could not be saved to history.

preferencesSaveFailed.message: Could not save your options. Change them again to retry.

preferencesLoadFailed.message: Could not load your options. Using defaults.

invalidLength.message: Enter a whole number from 8 to 64.

historyDescription.message: Only used passwords. Keep records for $DURATION$.

settingsDescription.message: Passwords are added to history after copying or insertion.

retentionExplanation.message: The period applies to all records from the time each password was used. Expired records are deleted the next time history is accessed.

privacyExplanation.message: History is stored locally in the secure macOS Keychain. Unused passwords are not recorded.

hyphenExplanation.message: The length includes hyphens. When enabled, two hyphens separate the password into three groups.

clearConfirmation.message: All saved passwords for this profile will be permanently deleted.

disableConfirmation.message: All saved passwords for this profile will be permanently deleted. New passwords will no longer be saved.

error_privateMode.message: History and insertion are unavailable in private windows. You can still generate and copy passwords.

error_nativeUnavailable.message: Could not open secure history. Reopen QuietPass in Safari and try again.

error_storageUnavailable.message: Secure history is unavailable. Make sure the macOS Keychain is unlocked.

error_noField.message: Select a text field on the page, then reopen QuietPass.

error_ambiguousField.message: Could not identify a single field. Use Copy instead.

error_pageUnavailable.message: Safari did not allow access to this page. Allow the extension on this website or use Copy.

error_fieldChanged.message: The selected field changed or did not accept the password. Select it again.

error_invalidRequest.message: Could not complete the action. Close and reopen QuietPass.

error_generic.message: Could not complete the action. Try again.
